LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SYMBOLS/CHARACTERS OF THE ALPHABET

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you develop a good handwriting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. copy words and sentences accurately
2. appreciate the characters of the Arabic Alphabet

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: SYMBOLS/CHARACTERS OF THE ALPHABET
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet for Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. copy words and sentences accurately
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the characters of the Arabic Alphabet
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Symbols/Characters of the Alphabet important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you develop a good handwriting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. copy words and sentences accurately
2. appreciate the characters of the Arabic Alphabet

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
